title: Silhouette first for multi-height turntable captures: cross-direction depth check, mask growth, gated hull correction, 2026-10-12
inputs: YCB 006_mustard_bottle and 035_power_drill rgb_highres, cameras N1-N5, 60 photos each, own lens-undistorted photos, own masks (mustard: background contrast; drill: own SAM), own recovered cameras (turntable solver, --turntable-rings 5). Supplied poses, rig extrinsics, masks and depth not used. Google scans only for scoring, each mesh with its own ICP similarity fit (differences of a few hundredths at 0.5 % are within the fit).

settings.cross_check: false by default; tolerance 0.004, votes 2, directions 20-80 degrees, up to 16 views
settings.mask_grow: false by default; first pass over all but the finest level, masks-grown written, run restarted from them; mask_grow_close 2
settings.mesh_hull_correction: 0 by default (off); sigma in voxels; mesh_hull_correction_gate 1

mustard_silhouette_only_original_masks.note: hull thickness / length 0.925 / 0.995 of the scan

single_turn_objects.note: six 3DLF objects from their own default depths, fusion and mesh only, scans post hoc
single_turn_objects.conclusion: not a default; no automatic choice (kept fraction 0.86 against 0.94 is too thin a margin on eight captures; hull overshoot does not separate the cases)

defaults_unchanged: drill default mesh sha256 equals the one recorded on 2026-10-11; Bunny and Lucy fusion-only meshes byte-identical before and after
rejected: hard or soft carve margin (depth carves only beyond a fixed distance)
cross-checked depth as the surface (mustard 0.71/0.88/0.96, lumpy)
correction without the scatter gate (mustard lumpy at sigma 2, gouged at sigma 8)
mask growth after matching without matching again (mustard 0.44/0.75/0.97): the depth search is bounded by the hull of the tight masks
mask growth with a 15-pixel closing (drill 0.767/0.896/0.992: fills concave silhouette corners)
checks: 214 library tests and 3 geometry audit tests with Metal, rustfmt, clippy for native all-targets with and without capi, threaded WebAssembly build. The wasm32 clippy run reports two findings in src/gpu/mod.rs, which this change does not touch.
limits: Two objects. Sheets inspected for both (smooth, closed; no fine relief). The six-object adoption gate was not passed and nothing is adopted as a default. No browser run, no memory measurement beyond native peak resident 5.3-5.7 GB. mask_grow about doubles the matching time of the coarser levels. No patent review of these steps; no third-party code.
